name: OpenClaw

name: Claude Code

name: OpenCode
notes: Open-source coding agent.

name: Goose
notes: Extensible open-source AI agent with strong CLI workflow support.

name: Crush
notes: Terminal-native agentic coding experience.

name: Aider
notes: CLI-first multi-file code editing assistant.

name: OpenHands
notes: Autonomous coding agent with sandboxed workflow orientation.

name: Cline
notes: VS Code agentic coding assistant.

name: Continue
notes: IDE-native coding assistant with model flexibility.

name: Cursor
notes: Commercial editor-centered AI coding assistant.

name: Superwhisper
notes: Voice input and speech-to-text productivity layer for developers. Used for voice-dictated coding commands and research queries, not only text summarization.

name: Onlook
notes: AI-first visual builder for React apps; a primary build surface rather than just an orchestration wrapper.

name: oh-my-openagent
notes: Open agent harness and orchestration wrapper.

name: oh-my-claudecode
notes: Teams-first multi-agent orchestration for Claude Code.

name: Aperant
notes: Autonomous multi-session AI coding system.

name: ralph-claude-code
notes: Autonomous Claude Code loop wrapper for PRD-driven iterative execution. PMs write the PRDs that ralph executes.

name: open-ralph-wiggum
notes: Loop controller for multiple coding agent backends.

name: SuperClaude Framework
notes: Configuration framework enhancing Claude Code workflows.

name: claudecodeui
notes: Web and mobile UI for remote coding agent sessions.

name: agentapi
notes: HTTP API abstraction for multiple coding agents.

name: Superset
notes: Desktop IDE / orchestration surface for parallel Claude Code, Codex, and related agents.

name: CCPM
notes: Project management skill system using GitHub Issues and worktrees for parallel agent execution.

name: Refly
notes: Open-source skills/workflow builder spanning Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and more.

name: Claude Squad
notes: Manager for multiple AI terminal agents including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.

name: Crystal
notes: Desktop manager for multiple Codex / Claude Code sessions across git worktrees.

name: AutoResearch
notes: Karpathy reference repo for autonomous research loops: agent modifies code, runs fixed-budget experiments, keeps or discards changes, and repeats. Important as a research-native workflow signal and origin point for multiple forks.

name: VibeSDK
notes: Platform SDK for building vibe-coding systems; more architecture/platform than direct end-user comparison target.

name: Claude Code Best Practice
notes: Comprehensive agentic engineering curriculum: Commands/Agents/Skills abstractions, 69 tips from Boris Cherny (Claude Code creator), comparative analysis of 10 workflow frameworks. 43.7k stars, #1 GitHub Trending 2026-04-15. Teaches progression from 'vibe coding' to production agentic systems. Accessible from beginner to advanced.

name: Awesome Vibe Coding
notes: Curated list of vibe-coding references; useful for discovery, not canonical taxonomy.

name: OpenMemory
notes: Local persistent memory layer for LLM applications.

name: cipher
notes: Memory layer for coding agents via MCP.

name: serena
notes: Semantic retrieval and editing toolkit for coding agents.

name: Context7
notes: Up-to-date documentation and context layer for LLMs and AI code editors; discovery via vibe-coding topic, classified by clawfit as context infrastructure.

name: ouroboros
notes: Workflow or interaction loop utility to support human-agent productivity.

name: Kaku
notes: Terminal application built for AI coding; better understood as interface/productivity layer than core agent runtime.

name: Hermes Agent
notes: Adaptive open-source agent from NousResearch; designed to grow with the user over sessions. 40+ tool integrations, messaging platform support (Telegram, Slack, Discord), built-in cron scheduler.

name: obsidian-skills
notes: Agent skill pack for Obsidian: teaches agents to use Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, and the Obsidian CLI. First-party skill pack from Obsidian CEO.

name: Shannon
notes: Autonomous AI pentester: reads source code, identifies attack surfaces, generates and executes exploits. Domain-specialized Level 1 agent for security workflows. High governance requirement. Primary users: security researchers and penetration testers.

name: Ghost Pepper
notes: Hold-to-talk local STT for macOS using Whisper; fully offline, no audio leaves device. Privacy-first alternative to Superwhisper for confidential environments. Used to dictate research queries and summaries to agents — voice input layer, not a code generator.

name: Career-Ops
notes: AI-powered job search pipeline on Claude Code: offer evaluation, tailored PDF CVs, Playwright portal scraping, 14 skill modes.

name: claude-peers-mcp
notes: MCP server enabling ad-hoc peer messaging between Claude Code instances on the same machine via a local SQLite broker.

name: pi-generative-ui
notes: Reverse-engineered Claude.ai's show_widget tool rebuilt for the pi macOS agent; streams interactive HTML/SVG widgets into native WKWebView windows.

name: superpowers
notes: Agentic skills framework + software development methodology. Shell-first for maximum runtime compatibility. 231k stars (2026-06-18; was 145k at first entry) — largest harness/SSOT repo in taxonomy. 'That works' framing targets reliability over novelty. Explicitly targets team productivity, not just individual developers.

name: Archon
notes: Open-source harness builder for AI coding; generates deterministic and repeatable harness configurations. Harness-generator sub-type distinct from harness runtimes.

name: rowboat
notes: Open-source AI coworker with native (first-class) memory. 'Coworker' framing implies persistent task ownership across sessions. Memory is built-in, not an add-on MCP. Targets teams where persistent context across PM/exec/dev is essential.

name: multica
notes: Open-source managed agents platform; 'turn coding agents into real teammates — assign tasks, track progress.' Team-oriented multi-agent management with task assignment and progress tracking.

name: Twill.ai
notes: YC S25 managed cloud agent service. Async delegation model: submit tasks, agents work in cloud, receive PRs as output. No local setup; fire-and-forget with PR output. First managed cloud agent service in taxonomy.

name: Strix
notes: Open-source autonomous AI security testing platform. Teams of agents run code dynamically, find vulnerabilities, and validate through PoC execution — not static analysis. CI/CD integration via GitHub Actions. Distinct from Shannon: developer self-service shift-left security testing vs. expert pentester workflow. 23k+ stars.

name: GBrain
notes: MIT-licensed personal knowledge base for agents by YC CEO Garry Tan. Markdown+PGLite (Postgres) backend; agents read before each response, write back after. Works natively with OpenClaw and Hermes Agent. CLI via bun. MCP support incoming. Local-first markdown+git as source of truth — human-inspectable, diffable, privacy-friendly.

name: DureClaw
notes: Cross-machine multi-agent orchestration. Claude Code orchestrator + Phoenix WebSocket server + oah-agent workers. Heterogeneous AI backends (claude/opencode/gemini/aider). MCP plugin via @dureclaw/mcp. Mac/Linux/Windows/Raspberry Pi. By hongsw.

name: AnythingLLM
notes: Self-hosted all-in-one AI productivity platform. Document chat (RAG), no-code agent builder, MCP compatible, 40+ LLM providers, multi-user with permissions. Docker or desktop app.

name: DeepTutor
notes: Agent-native personalized learning platform by HKUDS. 5 modes (Chat, Deep Solve, Quiz, Deep Research, Math Animator). RAG-based Knowledge Hub. Personal TutorBots with independent memory. Agent-Native CLI. Port 8001/3782.

name: korean-law-mcp
notes: Korean law MCP server. 39 APIs consolidated into 14 tools (v3.0). 82% context cost reduction from v2. 17 legal domains. HWPX/HWP/PDF/XLSX/DOCX document processing. Hosted endpoint available.

name: ATLAS
notes: Adaptive Test-time Learning. 74.6% LiveCodeBench pass@1 with frozen Qwen3-14B. ~$0.004/task (electricity only). 3-stage pipeline: PlanSearch + Geometric Lens + self-verify repair. Fully local, no API calls. Min 16GB GPU VRAM.

name: pi-mono
notes: 7-package monorepo: pi-ai (multi-provider LLM API), pi-agent-core (runtime), pi-coding-agent (CLI), pi-tui (terminal UI), pi-web-ui (chat components), pi-mom (Slack bot), pi-pods (vLLM GPU pods). Parent of pi-generative-ui plugin ecosystem.

name: Polysona
notes: 10 psychology frameworks to extract multi-persona profiles. 5-agent pipeline: Profiler→Trendsetter→Content-Writer→Virtual-Follower→Admin. Portable persona files (persona.md, nuance.md). Cross-agent: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode.

name: ralph
notes: Autonomous AI agent loop that executes PRD items iteratively. TypeScript. 15k+ stars — highest-starred ralph-family implementation. PRD-driven iterative execution model with loop discipline for solo/small teams. PMs write the PRDs that ralph executes.

name: Claudraband
notes: Claude Code harness for power users. Explicit senior-developer positioning — between simple configuration wrappers and full team orchestrators. 85 HN points at launch.

name: VoxCPM
notes: Tokenizer-free TTS for multilingual speech generation by OpenBMB. 11k+ stars. Lower latency voice output layer for agent pipelines; fills Level 7 voice output gap alongside Ghost Pepper (input). Multilingual by architecture.

name: get-shit-done (gsd)
notes: Light-weight meta-prompting, context engineering and spec-driven development system. 52k+ stars (GitHub Trending 2026-04-14). Three-layer vocabulary: meta-prompting + context engineering + spec-driven development. Distinct from claude-code-best-practice (Markdown-only) and SuperClaude Framework (config-heavy).

name: hermes-paperclip-adapter
notes: Adapter for running Hermes Agent as managed employee in Paperclip platform. 8 inference providers, 30+ native tools, 80+ loadable skills. MCP integration. Default model: claude-sonnet-4.

name: Claude Code Routines
notes: Anthropic-managed cloud runner for Claude Code (research preview, 2026-04). Saved Claude Code configurations with three trigger types: schedule (cron), API (HTTP POST + bearer token), and GitHub events (PRs, pushes, issues, CI runs). Sessions run autonomously on Anthropic cloud; no local machine required. Counts against daily run allowance. Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise plans. /schedule CLI for creation and management.

name: vercel-labs/open-agents
notes: Official Vercel Labs open-source template for building cloud-hosted agents. TypeScript-first, production-oriented. Vercel platform vendor entry into agent architecture — lowers activation energy for cloud agent deployment among front-end/full-stack developers already in the Vercel ecosystem. 2,611 stars, +915 in one day (2026-04-16).

name: cognee
notes: Graph-native knowledge engine for AI agent memory. Builds knowledge graphs over documents, code, and conversations — enables reasoning over relationships, not just vector similarity. 6-line API (add/cognify/search). MCP-compatible; integrates with LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, OpenHands. Multi-modal: handles documents, images, code. Self-hosted; any LLM backend. 15,788★.

name: Voicebox
notes: Open-source voice synthesis studio. TypeScript-first; higher-level than VoxCPM. Voice cloning, style transfer, multi-speaker management. 19,049★ (surpasses VoxCPM). Natural pairing for TypeScript-first orgs building voice-enabled agent interfaces. Self-hostable MIT license.

name: Claude-Code-Game-Studios
notes: Domain-specialized Claude Code harness for game development. 49 AI agents + 72 workflow skills organized into a coordination system mirroring a real game studio hierarchy (design, code, asset, QA, publishing). Shell-based, Claude Code native. 10,395 stars (2026-04-16). First high-signal Level 2/3 harness specialized for a non-software-engineering domain — signals domain-vertical harness fragmentation.

name: chrome-devtools-mcp
notes: Official MCP server from the Chrome DevTools team. Exposes browser DOM, network, console, performance, and storage via MCP to any agent. Enables live browser state as a first-class tool for QA, debugging, and UI iteration workflows. 35,846★ — highest-starred MCP server in this taxonomy.

name: openai-agents-python
notes: OpenAI's official lightweight Python framework for multi-agent workflows. Handoffs, routing, tool calling, async execution. Vendor-published harness — same provenance class as Claude Code Routines and Anthropic Managed Agents. 21,803★. Competes with LangGraph/deepagents at Level 2; lightweight framing targets developers who found LangGraph too complex.

name: Thunderbolt
notes: Privacy-first cross-platform AI client from the Thunderbird organization. 'AI You Control: Choose your models. Own your data. Eliminate vendor lock-in.' Compatible with Ollama, llama.cpp, and OpenAI-compatible APIs. Web, iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, Windows. MPL-2.0; under security audit for enterprise readiness. First on-premises AI client with Mozilla-ecosystem provenance. 2,205★ (2026-04-20).

name: omi
notes: Ambient AI that continuously watches screen and listens to audio, proactively surfacing suggestions. Flutter/Dart; cross-platform. Distinct from Ghost Pepper (hold-to-talk) and Superwhisper (dictation): omi is passive and always-on rather than push-to-activate. First entry in taxonomy for proactive ambient AI advisor model. 9,824★.

name: Langfuse
notes: Open-source LLM engineering platform: observability, metrics, evals, prompt management, playground, datasets. 25,601★. Self-hostable (MIT) or managed cloud. Native integrations with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Anthropic, LiteLLM. Production observability for deployed agent systems — distinct from pre-deployment benchmarks.

name: Zed
notes: GPU-accelerated code editor (Rust, 120fps) with native parallel agents via Threads Sidebar (released 2026-04-22). Multiple simultaneous agent threads per window with per-thread AI backend mixing, filesystem scope isolation, and worktree isolation. First IDE to absorb Level 2 multi-agent orchestration as a first-class editor feature — signals IDE-harness convergence.

name: browser-harness
notes: Self-healing browser automation from the browser-use team. Gives LLM raw Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) access + helpers.py; when steps fail, the LLM reads errors, self-edits helpers.py, and retries mid-task. Anti-framework stance: no Playwright/Selenium wrappers. HN Show HN 77 pts (2026-04-25). New Level 4c sub-type: self-healing browser automation (vs. deterministic Libretto; vs. MCP-mediated chrome-devtools-mcp).

name: Roo Code
notes: VS Code extension that frames itself as 'a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.' Multi-persona role-based agent model (architect, developer, reviewer) operating within a single IDE session. 23,503★ (GitHub Trending 2026-04-26). Direct Level 1 competitor to Cline; distinct by offering multi-role orchestration inside VS Code rather than a single-assistant model.

name: marketingskills
notes: Marketing domain skill pack for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, ad copy, campaign analysis skills. 23,796★ (GitHub Trending 2026-04-24). First high-signal L4b domain pack for marketing/growth roles — extends skill-pack layer beyond developer and knowledge-work contexts into business/marketing. Largest-starred non-dev domain skill pack in this taxonomy.

name: academic-research-skills
notes: Academic research domain skill pack for Claude Code. 4 skill categories: Deep Research (13 agents, 7 modes), Academic Paper writing (12 agents), Peer Review simulation (7 agents), Pipeline orchestrator (10-stage with integrity checkpoints). Slash commands: /ars-plan, /ars-lit-review, /ars-full. Integrity verification and human oversight emphasis. CC BY-NC 4.0 license restricts commercial use. 16k+ stars (GitHub Trending 2026-05-21).

name: Anthropic Knowledge Work Plugins
notes: First-party Anthropic plugin pack for knowledge workers. 11 specialized plugins: Productivity, Sales, Customer Support, Product Management, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Data, Enterprise Search, Bio-Research, and Plugin Management. Bundles domain expertise, MCP connectors for 40+ enterprise tools (Slack, Notion, Jira, HubSpot, Linear, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Figma, Asana, Microsoft 365), slash commands, sub-agents, and role-specific workflows. Apache-2.0. 14k stars.

name: Supermemory
notes: Cloud-native memory API ranked #1 on LongMemEval (81.6%), LoCoMo, and ConvoMem. Hybrid RAG + user-profile memory (~50ms retrieval), native MCP server for Claude/Cursor, automatic contradiction resolution and forgetting. 23k stars.

name: Odysseus
notes: Self-hosted, privacy-first AI workspace (Docker Compose, v1.0). Hardware-aware model recommendations for 270+ catalogued models, autonomous agents with MCP tool support, email/calendar integration, multi-step research. Direct comparator to clawfit's recommendation problem.

name: CopilotKit
notes: Frontend SDK for embedding AI agents into React/Angular applications. Introduces the AG-UI Protocol — open standard for bidirectional streaming between agents and UIs. Components: CopilotChat, CopilotTextarea, CopilotTask. Human-in-the-loop hooks via useCopilotAction. Compatible with LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, and custom backends. 32.7k stars (GitHub Trending 2026-06-06).

name: revfactory/harness
notes: Claude Code plugin that generates domain-specific agent team architectures via 6 patterns (pipeline, fan-out/fan-in, expert pool, producer-reviewer, supervisor, hierarchical). Generates agents + skills with dry-run validation. L3 meta-factory; complements Archon (runtime config). 4.5k stars.

name: phuryn/pm-skills
notes: PM Skills Marketplace with 68 skills across 9 plugins: Discovery, Strategy, Execution, Market Research, Data Analytics, Go-to-Market, Marketing & Growth, Toolkit, AI Shipping. Encodes Teresa Torres / Marty Cagan / Alberto Savoia PM frameworks into reusable slash-command workflows (/discover, /strategy, /write-prd). Multi-runtime: Claude Cowork+Code primary; also Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, Kiro. 13,408★ (GitHub Trending 2026-06-10). First PM-specialist L4b domain pack; confirms L4 skill fragmentation by org role.

name: codebase-memory-mcp
notes: C-native MCP server that indexes codebases into a persistent knowledge graph. 158 languages via vendored tree-sitter grammars. 14 MCP tools: call-chain tracing, dead-code detection, Cypher-like graph queries. Claims 99.2% token reduction vs file-by-file (3,400 vs 412,000 tokens). Sub-ms queries, indexes Linux kernel in 3 min. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Zed, Aider. 5.2k stars (GitHub Trending 2026-06-18).

name: NVIDIA SkillSpector
notes: Two-stage static+LLM security scanner for AI agent skills. 64 vulnerability patterns across 16 categories including MCP protocol threats. SARIF output for CI/CD integration. Vendor-neutral: targets Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI skills.

name: Kilo Code
notes: Multi-IDE open-source agentic coding agent (VS Code, JetBrains, CLI). 5 specialized agents: Code (implementation), Plan (architecture), Ask (codebase Q&A), Debug (troubleshooting), Review (quality). 500+ model support with mid-task switching; zero API key lock-in. `kilo run --auto` for headless CI/CD autonomous mode. First L1 coding agent with confirmed VS Code + JetBrains reach. 22,109★ (GitHub Trending 2026-06-19, 1,345 today).

name: headroom
notes: Python library for compressing tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. Operates at the pre-call boundary — reduces token consumption mid-pipeline rather than at prompt level. 38,632★ (GitHub Trending 2026-06-20). Complements codebase-memory-mcp and Context7 as a context-budget management utility.

name: OpenMontage
notes: Open-source agentic video production system: 12 pipelines, 52 tools, 500+ agent skill files. Orchestrates Claude/Cursor/Copilot into end-to-end video studios. Budget governance and quality gates built in. 7,041★ (GitHub Trending 2026-06-21). AGPLv3; Python 89.5%.

name: open-code-review
notes: AI code review agent from Alibaba (2 years internal production use). Reads git diffs, uses LLM tool-use loop to generate line-level structured review comments. Built-in rule set: NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection. Supports OpenAI and Anthropic. Deploys as CLI, Claude Code skill, or Codex plugin. 8.2k★ (GeekNews + GitHub Trending 2026-06-22). Apache-2.0.

name: crawl4ai
notes: Open-source LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper. Converts any URL into clean markdown/structured data optimized for LLM context windows. Async Python, Playwright backend for dynamic sites. MCP-compatible; can be wrapped as an agent tool. 71,812★ (GitHub Trending 2026-07-10). Primary use: retrieval layer feeding research agents.

name: mattpocock/skills
notes: Skills for Real Engineers — sourced directly from Matt Pocock's .claude directory. TypeScript educator with 60k+ YouTube subscribers; practitioner-derived skill pack targeting production engineering workflows rather than tutorial or synthetic prompts. 164,586★ (GitHub Trending 2026-07-11) — largest single-author engineer-focused skill pack in tracked ecosystem. Shell format enables cross-harness portability.

name: addyosmani/agent-skills
notes: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents by Addy Osmani (Google Chrome DevRel). Cross-agent design: works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other coding agents. 76,807★ (GitHub Trending 2026-07-11). First tracked cross-agent skill pack from a named Google engineering author; 'production-grade' positioning implies real-workload validation, not experimental prompts. JavaScript-dominant, targeting web/front-end engineers.

name: stitch-skills
notes: Library of agent skills for Google Stitch enabling design-to-code workflows. Three modular suites: stitch-design, stitch-build, stitch-utilities. Follows the Agent Skills open standard (SKILL.md + scripts + knowledge bases). Works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex. 6,735★ (GitHub Trending 2026-07-11). First tracked MCP-native skill pack — skills that consume a specific MCP server's APIs (Stitch MCP) rather than generic web/CLI calls. Targets front-end developers with design system workflows.

name: claude-code-templates
notes: 29k-star community collection of Claude Code configurations: agents, slash commands, MCPs, hooks, settings. Companion site aitmpl.com lets users browse and install 100+ components via CLI. Includes session analytics dashboard and plugin management.

name: Agnost AI
notes: Production monitoring platform that reads real agent conversations to detect failure patterns, churn risk, and broken workflows, then auto-opens PRs with proposed fixes. OpenTelemetry-native. YC S26.
